title: useR! 2025 program
hook: This week we're exploring the program for the useR! 2025 conference. useR! 2025 will be hosted at Duke University in Durham, NC, USA from August 8-10, 2025. The conference will feature keynote presentations from leading R developers and data scientists, technical talks and tutorials, interactive tutorials and training sessions, poster presentations, networking opportunities, and both in-person and virtual attendance options (with the virtual conference taking place on August 1, 2025). The event hashtag is #useR2025, so when sharing your TidyTuesday creations this week, please add this hashtag as well! useR! conferences are annual nonprofit gatherings organized by R community volunteers and supported by the R Foundation. These conferences have been the premier global venue for the R community since 2004, bringing together R developers, users, and enthusiasts from around the world.
questions: Create an interactive conference program app
Build a data visualization that inspires folks to participate in useR! 2025
